about: Defects planted in evals/fixtures/site. A live quick or full run against that site, served on localhost, must report each one; `qacheck.py expect <report.json> <this file>` checks it. Matching: same category, the page path ends with `page`, and one `match` word appears in the issue's title or evidence.

defects.why: a load handler calls a function that does not exist
the Pricing link points at a page that is not there (404)
the Save button has no handler: clicking it changes nothing on the page
the team image has no alt attribute
